requirements.text: The app should provide a consolidated view of all accounts, including checking, savings, and credit cards, to allow for quick access to balances.
The app should send real-time notifications for transactions, including the amount spent, the merchant, and the updated balance.
The app should include budgeting tools that allow users to set spending limits for various categories and send alerts when nearing those limits.
The app should feature smooth and intuitive navigation to ensure ease of use and a modern feel.
The app should incorporate security measures such as biometric login options (fingerprint or face recognition) to protect user data and ensure compliance with regulations.
